an5.206:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāme avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho
an5.206:1.4: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu kāme avītarāgo hoti avigatacchando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho tassa cittaṃ na manati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya
an5.206:1.5: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya ayaṃ paṭhamo cetaso vinibandho.
an5.206:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti …
an5.206:2.3: yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati …
an5.206:2.4: aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti
an5.206:2.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vāti tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya
an5.206:2.6: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya ayaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandho.
